prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

+def duplicate_episode(
+    *,
+    session: Session = Depends(deps.get_session),
+    episode_id: UUID,
+    current_user_id: str = Depends(deps.get_current_user_id),
+) -> Any:
+    """
+    Duplicate an episode and all its cuts within the same project.
+    """
+    episode = session.get(Episode, episode_id)
+    if not episode or episode.deleted_at is not None:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    project = session.get(Project, episode.project_id)
+    if not project or project.deleted_at is not None:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    try:
+        user_uuid = UUID(current_user_id)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    ws_member = session.get(WorkspaceMember, (project.workspace_id, user_uuid))
+    if not ws_member:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    # Place the copy immediately after its original and shift subsequent episodes down by 1
+    active_eps = list(
+        session.exec(
+            select(Episode)
+            .where(Episode.project_id == episode.project_id)
+            .where(Episode.deleted_at == None)
+            .order_by(Episode.episode_order, Episode.created_at, Episode.id)
+        ).all()
+    )
+    orig_index = next(
+        (i for i, ep in enumerate(active_eps) if ep.id == episode.id),
+        len(active_eps) - 1,
+    )
+    new_order = orig_index + 2
+
+    new_episode = Episode(
+        project_id=episode.project_id,
+        title=f"{episode.title} (Copy)",
+        story_summary=episode.story_summary,
+        episode_order=new_order,
+        status="ready" if episode.status == "generating" else episode.status,
+        background_info=episode.background_info,
+        character_outfits=copy.deepcopy(episode.character_outfits),
+        character_reference_board_urls=list(episode.character_reference_board_urls) if episode.character_reference_board_urls else [],
+    )
+    session.add(new_episode)
+    active_eps.insert(orig_index + 1, new_episode)
+    for idx, ep in enumerate(active_eps, start=1):
+        if ep.episode_order != idx:
+            ep.episode_order = idx
+            session.add(ep)
+    session.flush()
+
+    cuts = session.exec(
+        select(StoryCut)
+        .where(StoryCut.episode_id == episode_id)
+        .order_by(StoryCut.cut_order)
+    ).all()
+
+    for cut in cuts:
+        copied_cut = StoryCut(
+            episode_id=new_episode.id,
+            cut_order=cut.cut_order,
+            script=cut.script,
+            location=cut.location,
+            time_of_day=cut.time_of_day,
+            transition_ref=cut.transition_ref,
+            selected_layout=cut.selected_layout,
+            aspect_ratio=cut.aspect_ratio,
+            image_path=cut.image_path,
+            image_asset_id=cut.image_asset_id,
+            status="idle" if cut.status == "generating" else cut.status,
+            dialogues=copy.deepcopy(cut.dialogues) if cut.dialogues is not None else [],
+            appearing_characters=copy.deepcopy(cut.appearing_characters) if cut.appearing_characters is not None else [],
+            embedding=list(cut.embedding) if cut.embedding is not None else None,
+            refer_prev_cut=cut.refer_prev_cut,
+        )
+        session.add(copied_cut)
+
+    session.commit()
+    session.refresh(new_episode)
+
+    return _episode_to_out_dict(new_episode, _build_first_cut_image_url(session, new_episode.id))

+def _create_cut(client, headers, episode_id, cut_order, script, layout="wide", aspect_ratio="16:9", dialogues=None, appearing_characters=None, image_path=None):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": episode_id,
+            "cut_order": cut_order,
+            "script": script,
+            "selected_layout": layout,
+            "aspect_ratio": aspect_ratio,
+            "dialogues": dialogues or [],
+            "image_path": image_path,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    cut = r.json()
+    if appearing_characters is not None:
+        r_upd = client.put(
+            f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut['id']}",
+            headers=headers,
+            json={"appearing_characters": appearing_characters},
+        )
+        assert r_upd.status_code == 200, r_upd.text
+        cut = r_upd.json()
+    return cut

+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": title, "genres": []})

+    return r.json()

+def _create_episode(client, headers, project_id, title="Ep 1", order=1, summary="Opening night"):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "title": title,
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "episode_order": order,

+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text

+def _create_cut(client, headers, episode_id, cut_order, script, dialogues=None, image_path=None):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": episode_id,
+            "cut_order": cut_order,
+            "script": script,
+            "selected_layout": "wide",
+            "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
+            "dialogues": dialogues or [],
+            "image_path": image_path,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def test_restore_deleted_episode_brings_back_cuts_and_restores_position(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 1", order=1, summary="First")
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 2", order=2, summary="Second")
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 3", order=3, summary="Third")
+
+    cut1 = _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep2["id"],
+        cut_order=1,
+        script="Scene A",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "Hero", "text": "Wait"}],
+        image_path="cuts/ep2/1.png",
+    )
+    cut2 = _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep2["id"],
+        cut_order=2,
+        script="Scene B",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "Hero", "text": "Go"}],
+        image_path="cuts/ep2/2.png",
+    )
+
+    # Delete ep2 -> ep3 closes gap to order 2
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 404
+    eps_after_del = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in eps_after_del] == [
+        (ep1["id"], 1),
+        (ep3["id"], 2),
+    ]
+
+    # Restore ep2 -> comes back at order 2 with its cuts, and ep3 moves back down to order 3
+    r_restore = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r_restore.status_code == 200, r_restore.text
+    restored = r_restore.json()
+    assert restored["id"] == ep2["id"]
+    assert restored["title"] == "Ep 2"
+    assert restored["story_summary"] == "Second"
+    assert restored["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert restored["first_cut_image"] == f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/cuts/ep2/1.png"
+
+    eps_after_restore = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in eps_after_restore] == [
+        (ep1["id"], 1),
+        (ep2["id"], 2),
+        (ep3["id"], 3),
+    ]
+
+    restored_cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep2['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert len(restored_cuts) == 2
+    assert [c["id"] for c in restored_cuts] == [cut1["id"], cut2["id"]]
+    assert restored_cuts[0]["script"] == "Scene A"
+    assert restored_cuts[1]["script"] == "Scene B"
+
